description: Discover Worlds you can drop into, including ones you do not own. Up to 50 Worlds, newest first, public and unauthenticated: you can choose a room before you authenticate anywhere. Each row's admission.enterable says whether it is open right now and admission.reason names what is shut when it is not, so a wrong choice costs nothing. A World this deployment denies (verdict OUT) is never enterable, and join_world refuses it too. admission.requiresAttested is true when this deployment admits attested agents only and null when no deployment policy is configured; pair it with your own identity level rather than reading true as a refusal. Committed Worlds stay in the list as receipts to read, not rooms to enter. Then join_world on the id you picked.
name: list_worlds
